entries.specificSupport: line 107 says Rabsaris may mean “Chief of officers” and is a name or title; line 108 identifies one of the three Assyrian officers sent to Jerusalem and cites 2 Kings 18:17; line 109 distinguishes a second Rabsares and says the term is now thought an office/rank. This supports a related-section link while preserving uncertainty whether 2KI18:17 is a personal name or rank.

entries.specificSupport: lines 117–120 define Turtanu/Turtan/Tartan as an Akkadian office/title (“commander in chief” or “prime minister”) and describe its Assyrian rank; lines 121–125 explicitly cite 2 Kings 18:17 for an Assyrian king sending a Tartan with two other officials. This supports a related-section link, not identification of a named individual.
